title: What was the gas consumption peak month for SME customers in 2013?
question: What was the gas consumption peak month for SME customers in 2013?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT SUBSTR(T2.Date, 5, 2) AS PeakMonth
FROM CustomerInfo AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2
  ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME'
  AND SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(T2.Date, 5, 2)
ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1
